target_customer: Insurers, reinsurers and brokers pricing coverage for autonomous trucks, robots and other physical AI, plus the autonomy companies seeking cover.
problem: Autonomous systems have almost no claims history, so insurers cannot price them. Valgo builds probabilistic simulations of routes, tasks and environments that output loss estimates.
business_model: B2B software and risk models sold to insurers; pricing not found

founders.name: Robert Moss
prior_employers: MIT Lincoln Laboratory (about 7 years, ACAS X)

founders.name: Sydney Katz
founders.background_notes: Co-author of the textbook Algorithms for Validation and Stanford lecturer.

founders.name: Jon Qian
prior_employers: Dai-ichi Life Holdings (head of corporate development, led over $5B M&A)
founders.background_notes: Described as an actuary with over 12 years in insurance leadership.

competitors.name: RiskCube
competitors.what: YC Fall 2024 brokerage selling coverage to AI, robotics, space and defense startups

technical_complexity.rationale: Building credible simulated loss distributions for novel autonomy systems is research level, drawing on the founders' safety validation work.

defensibility.rationale: Rare PhD level expertise and insurer relationships help, but insurers or AV firms could build in house and no customers are shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Insurers were retreating from AI risk in early 2026 per S&P Global; no incumbent copy found.

market_need_then: Insurers lack claims data for autonomy, and an S&P Global article from February 2026 describes insurers retreating from AI risk.

branding.domain_note: Uses valgo.ai; a YC jobs page lists valgo.dev. Legal name valgorithmic, inc., a public benefit corporation.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and rhythmic; AI is driving today. We model the risk.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear tagline and credible academic branding but name is similar to Volgo and other brands and no press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Valgo is an active Winter 2026 company whose founders combine Stanford autonomy safety research and insurance M&A experience, backed by Floodgate, Menlo Ventures (Anthology Fund) and Y Combinator per its own site. Amounts and customers are undisclosed, so no outcome can be judged.
notes: The company site names Floodgate, Menlo Ventures (Anthology Fund) and Y Combinator as backers without amounts or dates, so no round is recorded; VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed in March 2026 (aggregator, unverified). Location conflict: YC says San Francisco, one aggregator San Mateo. Koop Technologies is a competitor but its source is undated, so it is left out of the list. Competitor snippet from S&P Global February 2026 not opened.
